title: Title & Registration Services State Re-Review Charge on a Returned Packet
content:
When a returned Title & Registration Services packet goes back to the state, a state re-review charge is added: eight dollars (8.00) when the state took more than thirty calendar days from the order's most recent submission to its most recent return, four dollars (4.00) when it took fifteen to thirty days, and nothing otherwise. Kestrel funds this charge itself and adds it to the same remittance.

The most recent submission is the submission date shown on the title order before the packet goes back; the most recent return is the latest-dated state rejection entry on the order.

| Calendar days from most recent submission to most recent return | State re-review charge |
|---|---|
| more than 30 | 8.00 |
| 15 to 30 | 4.00 |
| 14 or fewer | nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, most recent submission 1 April)

| Most recent return | Days | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| 15 April | 14 | nothing |
| 16 April | 15 | 4.00 |
| 1 May | 30 | 4.00 |
| 2 May | 31 | 8.00 |
